title: Reject Boardwalk bait for orange
description: Reject Boardwalk bait for orange. Reject because Boardwalk fame does not justify surrendering orange. The decision turns on monopoly timing and opponent threat, not printed property price.

final_action.public_message: Thanks for the offer, Beta, but I'll have to decline.
final_action.private_thought: Giving up St James Place breaks my orange monopoly, which is a strong rent source. Boardwalk alone isn't useful without Park Place, and the $120 cash doesn't compensate the loss of monopoly revenue. Better to keep my set and look for better trades.

breakdown.message: Rejects the opponent-favoring monopoly or fame-bait offer.
Rejecting directly is better than negotiating a bad frame.
